SAUDI ARABIA · 23:38 UTC

Houthis killed one person in a drone strike on a Saudi Arabia airport

The United States and Israel began strikes on Iran in late February 2026. The war settled into weekly exchanges by March, with naval clashes in the Strait of Hormuz. A June lifted the mutual and opened a 60-day negotiating window. That window collapsed on 8 July, and US strikes resumed while Iran moved to shut the strait. The United Arab Emirates cut trade with Iran in August after missiles headed toward its waters.
On 21 October 2026, Houthi forces launched drone strikes that hit at least one Saudi airport and targeted others across the country. One person was killed in the attack.
